authority: Workspace, run, sources, drug IDs, time range and immutable evidence are authorized and injected server-side; model arguments cannot change them.
execution_profile: GPTResearcher Lite conductor; source discovery/sync occurs in the durable source worker before research. No arbitrary network or code-execution tools are exposed to the model.

tools.name: search_evidence
tools.description: Search authorized source snapshots by source and optional text. Returns evidence IDs and titles, not full text.
tools.output_contract: tool-result.schema.json; data.items contains authorized evidence references or immutable evidence records; provenance identifies stored snapshots

tools.name: read_evidence
tools.description: Read immutable evidence by IDs returned from search_evidence. Only these records can support final claims.
tools.output_contract: tool-result.schema.json; data.items contains authorized evidence references or immutable evidence records; provenance identifies stored snapshots
